{{Youmay|genders and sexes, such as male and female|[[Reproduction/Legends|reproduction]]}}
{{MultipleIssues|expand|image}}
{{Quote|Are you a boy or a girl?''"<br />"''Like, male or female?''"<br />"''Yeah, you know.''"<br />"''I don't know, actually. I mean, I know what you mean, but I don't know yet whether I am male or female. On my planet, it's not determined until age thirteen.|Boba Fett, a Human, and Garr, an Excargan|<ref name="Boba Fett: Crossfire">''[[Boba Fett: Crossfire]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Humanstar.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Human male and female]]
Most beings in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had a '''gender''' or a '''sex''', such as "female" or "male." Sexual characteristics and gender roles differed by [[Species/Legends|species]] for [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduction]], culture, or labor reasons.

==Description==
Most beings and creatures in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] had a '''gender''' or a '''sex'''. The physical and behavioral characteristics,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|multiple}}</ref> such gender roles<ref name="Kenobi">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref> and secondary sexual traits,<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> associated with particular genders differed among [[Species/Legends|species]] for reasons such as [[Reproduction/Legends|reproduction]], culture, or labor.<ref name="CSWE" /> Many genders<ref name="NJO Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> and sexes existed;<ref name="Remnant">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant]]''</ref> "female" and "male" were common to many species, but what defined those genders varied.<ref name="CSWE" /> Some beings were not gendered<ref name="X-Wing: The Krytos Trap">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref> and some species did not have a concept of gender.<ref name="Alien Encounters">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> Others alternated or changed their physical traits over [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="CSWE" />

[[Droid/Legends|Droids]], which were self-aware automata designed to perform tasks for organic beings,<ref name="NEG Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> could have masculine programming<ref name="NEG Characters">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> or a feminine personality;<ref name="CSWE 4B-X">{{CSWECite|I|249|4B-X}}</ref> if so, they would be addressed as and refer to themselves with the associated pronouns instead of "it."<ref name="NEG Droids" /> A restricted [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|intelligence]] profile of [[SCORPIO]], who had an 9-NIX rating on the [[Wreyn-Tsatke Cyber-Psychology Scale]], noted that she may have identified herself as female.<ref name="SCORPIO">{{TORcite|type=codex|Intelligence Profile: SCORPIO (Agent)}}</ref>

==Genders by species==
===Humanoids===
{{Quote|Now you're going to tell me that you knew all this stuff because girls mature faster than boys.''"<br />"Women, ''Jacen, women mature faster than boys.|Twin siblings [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], joking about which twin's gender is wiser|<ref name="NJO Ruin" />}}
Some [[Human/Legends|Humans]] believed that females achieved maturity at a quicker rate than males. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] teased her twin brother, [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]], about being more mature than him to lighten the mood as they discussed their futures.<ref name="NJO: Dark Tide II: Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> In the primarily Human [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture, any gender was welcome in their ranks,<ref name="CSWE Mandalorian">{{CSWECite|II|284|Mandalorian}}</ref> and their [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] language did not have gender-specific terms.<ref name="CSWE Mando'a">{{CSWECite|II|285|Mando'a}}</ref>

[[Excargan]]s were genderless until around thirteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, when their bodies changed and their gender was determined. They did not know in advance what their future gender would be. Ten-year-olds [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], a Human [[Cloning/Legends|clone]], and [[Garr]], an Excargan, once discussed Garr's frustrations with how other children treated everyone as a boy or a girl instead of just a person. Fett said the others were stupid, and he would treat Garr as a friend.<ref name="Boba Fett: Crossfire" /> Later in life, Fett was aware of around a dozen genders among alien species.<ref name="The Last One Standing">{{StoryCite|story=The Last One Standing: The Tale of Boba Fett|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>

[[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] had distinct gender roles that included their [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and behavior. For instance, female Tuskens would tend to the [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]] while the males fought.<ref name="Kenobi" />

Some [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] species had genders not found in others, such as the [[Fnessian]]s that had one called thos.<ref name="No Disintegrations">[[No Disintegrations (West End Games)|''No Disintegrations'']]</ref>

===Non-humanoids===
====Insectoids====
The [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] were insectoids that each played different reproductive roles throughout their life cycle, but it was inappropriate to address them as a particular gender or as individuals. Since they had hive minds, they used the names of their hives and plural pronouns.<ref name="X-Wing: The Bacta War">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref> Every three years, an adult [[X'Ting]] cycled between male and female<ref name="CSWE X'Ting">{{CSWECite|III|344|X'Ting}}</ref> through a three-[[Standard month/Legends|month]]-long metamorphosis in sexual phase called [[the Change]]. During the Change, wealthy X'Ting could consume [[viptiel]] to ease their emotional and physiological instability.<ref name="CWSE Change">{{CSWECite|I|119|Change, the}}</ref> Because gender was variable, it was not a factor in the X'Ting caste system.<ref name="CSWE X'Ting" /> As the [[Xi'Dec/Legends|Xi'Dec]] evolved, they developed 180 different, specialized sexes, each with adaptive abilities that suited both the constantly-changing environment of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Stic/Legends|Stic]], and the historical evolution of the Xi'Dec society. Six percent of the population were of the most common variety, [[Xi'Alpha]].<ref name="GG42">[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races'', Second Edition]]</ref>

Several insectoid species had a gender consisting of worker drones, such as the non-reproducing [[Flakax]] drones,<ref name="CSWE Flakax">{{CSWECite|I|278|Flakax}}</ref> the wingless [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] drones,<ref name="CSWE Geonosian">{{CSWECite|I|331-332|Geonosian}}</ref> and the facilitator drones of the [[Rakririan]]s.<ref name="Coruscant Nights I">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>

====Other non-humanoids====
{{Dialogue|Han Solo|Uh, Lord Jiliac, are you feeling&mdash;|Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Human idiot! Can't you see that Lord Jiliac is now ''Lady'' Jiliac? She is expecting! In her delicate condition, she really should not make this effort, but we Desilijic are nothing if not faithful to our duty!|Han Solo|Your pardon, Lady Jiliac. I am not familiar with your species' &hellip; uh, er &hellip; reproductive habits. I meant no offense.|Jiliac Desilijic Tiron|No offense taken. My people reproduce as they will, and I decided it was time for me to do so.|attr=Han Solo, Jabba Desilijic Tiure, and Jabba's aunt Jiliac Desilijic Tiron discuss her shift in gender|src=<ref name="The Hutt Gambit">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref>}}
Many [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] maintained one lifelong gender, most often male; however, some male Hutts would be regarded as female during a pregnancy. Hutts possessed multiple sex organs simultaneously,<ref name="DB Hutt">{{DB|species|hutt|Hutt}}</ref> and they could reproduce with another Hutt<ref name="Boba Fett: Murder Most Foul">''[[Boba Fett: Murder Most Foul]]''</ref> or conceive a [[Youngling/Legends|Huttlet]] without a partner. [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta's]] father, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], was his sole parent.<ref name="TCW novel">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> The Human male [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] had met [[Jiliac Desilijic Tiron]] prior to her pregnancy, and was subsequently admonished by Jabba for incorrectly referring to her as if she was still [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Jiliac. Solo quickly apologized to Lady Jiliac, and she did not take offense at his mistake.<ref name="The Hutt Gambit" />

The [[Filordus|Filordi]] reproduced asexually and did not have genders as a species;<ref name="Belly of the Beaast">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref> however, some individuals such as [[Verkul Seimbo]]<ref name="Holes">{{LivingForce|Blinking Eyes: Holes}}</ref> and [[Nui Gneppe]] were considered male.<ref name="Living Force Campaign Guide">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Several ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]]s allowed the player to choose the gender of the main character during gameplay, then that character later received a specified gender in other sources or appearances. Characters later identified as male include [[Rookie One]],<ref name="Rebel Assault II">''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]''</ref> [[Jaden Korr]],<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> and [[Revan/Legends|Revan]];<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] was later canonized as female<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> and named Meetra Surik.<ref name="TOR: Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref>
